Detail16.note: 16-bit greyscale PNG, LINEAR values. sRGB must stay OFF: the G8->BGRA8 sRGB fix-up exists only for G8, so a G16 with sRGB ON would be sampled undecoded

texture_import.importer_gotcha: Scripts/shuriken/ue_import_textures.py and Scripts/props/props_lib/ue_import_textures.py write their JSON next to the texture folder's PARENT by default, which would create a NEW file inside Exports/. Always set *_TEXTURE_OUT to a WorkFiles path. The props importer FAILS on unknown suffixes in a folder it scans, so new maps live in a Recolour/ subfolder, which neither importer's non-recursive glob reads.

PaperDetail_sRGB.note: T_PaperBomb_PaperDetail: RGB = paper weight / Paper Weight Scale, sRGB-ENCODED (the sampler decodes it); A = pooled red-ink weight, LINEAR (sRGB never touches alpha). Changed from the survey's linear BC7 by the generator: linear 8-bit RGB failed G-P1 by 4 levels under the black-ink cores; sRGB encoding holds 1 level.

InkWeights_linear.note: T_PaperBomb_InkWeights: R black wet, G black dry, B red wet, A red dry. Uncompressed: G-P1 was measured on the uncompressed weights; BC7 was never measured

math: Colour_f = Colour + max(0.01 - max3(Colour), 0)            (v2: pure black is lifted to ~#1A1A1A, hue kept)
Colour_e = Colour_f * min(1, LightestColour / max3(Colour_f)) (v2: very light picks scale down so the highlights keep detail)
C_hi   = min(DetailStrength, max(H, 0)); C_lo = lerp(DetailStrength, C_hi, DarkFollow)
n'     = n <= 1 ? pow(n, C_lo) : pow(n, C_hi)
E(C)   = El(C_lo) + Eh(C_hi) (cubic moment fits, covered texels only in v2)
K      = exp(-A(MipLevel) * max(1 - C_hi, 0)^P), A piecewise linear from the increments (v2: mip compensation)
MF_TintDetail.default_exactness: At the default Colour: Colour > 0.01 and < LightestColour (guards inactive), H >= 1 so C = 1, E(1) = DetailMean and K = exp(0) = 1, so Albedo = Colour * n: the item contract, at every mip (derive_constants.py gates).

MF_AlbedoRollOff.math: m = max channel; if m <= Knee: unchanged; else scale rgb by (Knee + (Limit-Knee)*(1-exp(-(m-Knee)/(Limit-Knee)))) / m. Keeps the hue and never exceeds Limit. With Knee >= Limit it is a hard min(rgb, Limit).

paper_defaults.why: paperbomb_art Palette.ceiling_linear = 0.962 is the art's own clip

MF_NormalStrength.math: N' = normalize(lerp(float3(0,0,1), N, Strength)); Strength 1 = unchanged

math: BaseColor = lerp(BaseColor, LetteringColour, Ink); Roughness = lerp(Roughness, LetteringRoughness, Ink)
MF_LetteringBand.source: References/Kunai/LETTERING_HOWTO.md section 5; Rect in UNREAL UV0 (V flipped by the FBX importer)

math: StoredScale(c, k) = sRGBdecode(k * sRGBencode(c)) per channel (exact piecewise sRGB)
SatGain(c, s, g)  = lerp(Y(c), c, s) * g
v2: PoolGain_e = lerp(mean(RedPoolGain), RedPoolGain, saturate(sat(RedInk) / RedPoolDefaultSaturation)), sat(c) = (max3 - min3) / max3: a neutral red-ink pick pools neutral; the default is exact
MF_InkDerive.note: The functions depend on parameters only, so UE can evaluate them as preshaders. The gains make them exact at the default colours, and they stay inside [0,1] for any colour.

parameters.name: Colour
parameters.desc: The colour of this part: its average colour. Click the swatch and pick any colour (the picker's Hex sRGB field takes web colours). The weave, fibre and wear detail follow the new colour. Very light picks are capped by Lightest Colour so the highlights keep their detail; pure black is lifted to about #1A1A1A so the detail stays visible. The default is the shipped look.

parameters.name: Lightest Colour
parameters.desc: The lightest average brightness this part will take (linear). Lighter picks are scaled down to it, keeping their hue, so the highlights never blow out into flat white. Raise it for a brighter result with softer highlight detail (0.9 = no limit).

parameters.name: Use Original Baked Colours
parameters.desc: On = ignore the colour settings and show the original baked colour map exactly as shipped (fixed colour).

parameters.name: Detail Strength
parameters.desc: How strong the cloth or straw detail is. 1 = as shipped, 0 = flat colour. On very light colours the highlight detail is limited automatically, so values above 1 mainly deepen the darker weave.

parameters.name: Roughness Adjust
parameters.desc: Added to the baked roughness. Negative = shinier, positive = duller. 0 = as shipped.

parameters.name: Specular Strength
parameters.desc: Strength of the surface reflection. On the smoke bomb and the hat it scales the baked specular mask, which keeps the cloth from looking greyed. 0.5 = standard.

parameters.name: Normal Strength
parameters.desc: Strength of the normal map's weave and folds. 1 = as shipped, 0 = flat.

parameters.name: Cloth Sheen
parameters.desc: Optional soft, velvety cloth sheen (Unreal's Cloth shading model). Off by default: without it the part matches the original look more closely.

parameters.name: Sheen Colour
parameters.calibration: V4 sheen calibration (2026-09-26, WorkFiles/materials/ue_renders/sheen_calibration/sheen_compare.json): a flat wrap-coloured sphere under one key and one rim light, sheen-on/sheen-off ratio per N.V bin, Blender (Principled sheen 0.35, tint 0.62/0.60/0.56, roughness 0.35) vs Unreal. RMS log-ratio error: Default Lit (no Cloth lobe) 0.206; best Cloth pair Fuzz = tint x 0.35 = (0.217, 0.21, 0.196), Cloth 0.35: 0.259; the survey's Fuzz (0.62, 0.60, 0.56) Cloth 0.35: 0.477 (reads light grey). Unreal's Cloth lobe REPLACES the GGX specular, so it darkens the grazing rim that Blender's additive sheen brightens. Default: Cloth Sheen OFF; the calibrated pair is the default for buyers who turn it on.
parameters.desc: Colour of the soft sheen at grazing angles. Used when Cloth Sheen is on.

parameters.name: Sheen Amount
parameters.desc: Strength of the cloth sheen. Used when Cloth Sheen is on.

new_maps.script: Scripts/unreal/materials/maps/make_kunai_wrap_detail.py (Blender headless, opens Assets/Shuriken.blend READ-ONLY, never saves)
new_maps.recipe: Bake M_Kunai_Wrap Base Color (Dye = 0) on SM_Kunai_Plain_LOD0 into a FLOAT image, exactly as kunai_wrap.bake_kunai does: B._alone(lod0), _absorber(steel material), _wrap_uv(lod0), B._bake_channel(..., 'Base Color', float image), spec.wrap_px 1024, then B._fill with B._coverage. Y = luminance(linear rgb). Ymean = mean over covered texels (fill texels carry the mean). Ylo/Yhi = min/max of Y. d = (Y - Ylo) / (Yhi - Ylo), written as 16-bit. Colour = mean linear rgb, Bias = Ylo / Ymean, Scale = (Yhi - Ylo) / Ymean.
gates: G-K1 bake parity: sRGB8(float bake) vs the shipped T_Kunai_Wrap_BC.png: max |diff| <= 1 level, mean <= 0.2 (bake-noise tolerance the kunai freeze used)
G-K2 default model vs shipped BC: dE00 mean <= 0.5, p99 <= 1.5

new_maps.recipe: d16 = round(65535 * sRGBdecode(T_SmokeBomb_Detail.R / 255)). This is a lossless re-encoding: every sRGB8 level maps to a distinct 16-bit value. The equality gate proves it.
gates: decode(d16) vs sRGBdecode(Detail8): max abs <= 1/65535 x 0.5
model(Detail16) vs BC: 0 stored levels (as the shipped Detail)

new_maps.format: RGBA 8-bit PNG, LINEAR (colour type 6; props_lib.bake.write_png cannot write alpha: use a local writer)
new_maps.script: Scripts/unreal/materials/maps/make_paperbomb_recolour_maps.py (Blender headless; imports props_lib READ-ONLY and monkeypatches nothing on disk)
new_maps.recipe: see MATERIAL_PLAN.md 5.3: re-run bake.draw_art(spec, plan, seed=20260919, supersample=2) with paperbomb_art._composite and _downsample wrapped IN MEMORY to capture the 2x paper/red/black layers; build per-texel weights at 2x (W_P per channel = (clipped total - ink terms) / PaperColour; W_bw = a_b d_b K; W_bd = a_b (1-d_b) K; W_rw = (1-a_b) a_r d_r (1-p_r) K; W_rd = (1-a_b) a_r (1-d_r)(1-p_r) K; W_rp = (1-a_b) a_r p_r K); box-downsample 2:1 with paperbomb_art._down; compose into the atlas with atlas.compose (back face: W_P = back.base_colour / PaperColour, inks 0; rim: rim_gradient / PaperColour). RGB = W_P / PaperWeightScale, A = W_rp
gates: G-P1 recompose: sum(weights x default colours) vs the shipped T_PaperBomb_BC.png: max |diff| <= 1 stored level everywhere, dE00 mean <= 0.3

G-P2 derived colours at the defaults within 0.25 stored sRGB levels of the palette (survey: RedDry via stored-space 0.82 = (0.42653, 0.006926, 0.002855) vs Palette.red_dry (0.4269, 0.00694, 0.00286); RedPool with s = 0.30, gain (0.0791, 0.1032, 0.0782) is exact; BlackDry with paper mix t = 0.00624, gain (0.974, 1.003, 1.052) is exact)
G-P3 derived colours inside [0,1] for the stress colour set
G-P4 paper-bomb art modules byte-identical to WorkFiles/paperbomb/paused_2026-09-21/Scripts_props (checked 2026-09-26: identical)

survey_constants.note: computed from the CURRENT palette (props_lib/paperbomb_art.Palette, reference ink floor) and the survey's mean paper; the generator recomputes them from the palette it imports

new_maps.recipe: R W_bw, G W_bd, B W_rw, A W_rd (see above)

V1_source_twin.what: numpy twin of every graph (same math as the MFs) evaluated on the source PNGs
V1_source_twin.default_gate: per recolourable part, covered texels: dE00 mean <= 0.5, p99 <= 1.5 vs the BC PNG (smoke bomb / hat expected 0 levels)
V1_source_twin.steel: BC path is the map itself: nothing to test beyond UE capture

V2_ue_uvplane_basecolor.what: UE: engine Plane, orthographic SceneCapture2D at the texture's resolution, capture_source SCS_BASE_COLOR, RTF_RGBA32F, exported as EXR. The GBuffer stores base colour as 8-bit sRGB, so captures are quantised to 1 level
V2_ue_uvplane_basecolor.gate: default MI vs twin: |diff| <= 1 sRGB level at p99.9, mean <= 0.3 level; BC-direct MI vs PNG: reported (BC1 error), not gated
V2_ue_uvplane_basecolor.calibration: first capture the BC-direct instance and find the UV orientation (flip/rotation) by cross-correlating with the PNG

gates: clip: <= 0.1 % of covered texels with any channel >= 0.949
banding: in the 8-bit sRGB output, dominant channel inside its p1..p99 range: largest gap between consecutive occupied levels <= 3 AND occupied levels >= 0.5 x (p99 - p1 level span)

detail kept: std(log L_recolour) >= 0.25 x std(log L_default) (twin); Spearman rank corr(L_recolour, L_default) >= 0.98 on the UE 8-bit captures (the twin mapping is monotone, so on floats it is 1 by construction)
mean: dE00(part mean albedo, Colour x Detail Mean) <= 3 for colours whose max channel <= 0.85 (above that the roll-off takes over by design)
V3_recolour_stress.where: full twin on every part for all 8 colours, plus UE V2 captures for white, saturated_red and near_black on every recolourable part; for the paper bomb each of Paper / Black Ink / Red Ink is stressed alone
V3_recolour_stress.prototype_result_2026-09-26: WorkFiles/materials/survey/twin_prototype_f050.json (Dark Detail Follow 0.5, shipped Detail maps): default error <= 2e-16 linear on all three parts; clip 0 for every stress colour; max gap 3 (smoke bomb light colours, from the 8-bit source's own dark steps) / 2 (straw) / 1 (hat cloth); white keeps 0.34-0.40 of the log-contrast; white 0.8 means 0.754 / 0.766 / 0.772

verification.V4_lit: UE lit captures (SCS_FINAL_COLOR_HDR, fixed directional + fill rig, EXR) of every mesh: default MI vs BC-direct MI (dE00 mean <= 1.0 over the object mask); kunai wrap sheen on/off pair; smoke bomb ORM.A mask vs constant-0.5 pair (the +53 % must show); side-by-side with the Blender gallery renders for the look judge
verification.V5_persistence: fresh process: every MI's parent, overridden parameters equal to the spec, textures resolved, slot assignment on every LOD, recompile_material() == [] on the 3 masters, get_statistics() on every MI (PS instructions, samplers <= 16), texture flags incl. composite texture on the hat ORMs

build.recolour_constants_note: Scripts/unreal/materials/maps/derive_constants.py derives them from the Recolour maps; their params override recolour_maps.json. run_build.sh 'maps_check' verifies the sha256 chain.

master_defaults.note: v2: masters reference ONLY the neutral 8x8 textures in /Game/NinjaPack/Textures/Default (no item's maps: no dependency drag), and neutral parameter values (a flat grey preview). Every Base instance overrides them.

instance_chain.why: Buyer review: every instance was a direct child of the master, whose defaults were the smoke bomb's, so resetting a parameter on the hat or kunai silently gave the smoke bomb's colour and constants. Now MI_<Item>_<Part>_Base holds every texture and matched setting, and the buyer-facing MI_<Item>_<Part> (the one on the mesh) overrides only its colour(s): reset-to-default restores that part's shipped look.

build.clean_policy: v2: 'clean' deletes only the assets the spec authors (functions, masters, base, leaf and preset instances) and REFUSES if Materials/ or MaterialInstances/ hold anything else (a buyer's or artist's own variant would be listed, never deleted). Add variants as spec presets.

changes_v2: BLOCKER light colours: MF_TintDetail caps the mean at 'Lightest Colour' (per part, min(0.6, 0.9 / HighlightRatio^0.2)) so C_hi >= 0.2: no flat highlight plateau
MAJOR mips: MF_TintDetail multiplies by exp(-A(lod)(1-C_hi)^P), fitted per part on the Unreal mip chain (derive_constants.py): a recoloured part keeps its colour at distance
MAJOR black: Colour and Paper Colour get a hue-preserving floor (max channel >= 0.01): 000000 keeps its detail

MAJOR paper full intensity: Paper Colour is scaled to at most 'Paper Colour Limit' (0.962 / p99.9 paper weight) before the 0.962 ceiling: no clipped grain. The hard min stays (the art's own clip; a soft knee would change the default)
MINOR red pool: the pool gain's chroma fades with the red ink's saturation (neutral picks pool neutral)
MINOR constants over covered texels only (recolour_constants.json): Colour = the visible mean
MAJOR reset trap: MI_<Item>_<Part>_Base holds everything; the buyer MI overrides only its colour(s)
MAJOR dependency drag: masters reference only /Game/NinjaPack/Textures/Default 8x8 maps
MAJOR compatibility: Float Precision Mode Full on the fabric and paper masters; Used With Instanced Static Meshes preset on all three

MINOR tooltips in buyer language; one group scheme (01 Colour, 02 Detail, 03 Surface, 04 Sheen, 05 Lettering, 08 Advanced, 09 Textures); 'Use Baked Colour Map' renamed 'Use Original Baked Colours' and moved to 01 Colour; Steel Tint clamped
MINOR the kunai wrap ships Use Lettering OFF
MINOR clean deletes only spec'd assets; run_build.sh checks the Recolour map sha256 chain; paths derived from the script location

changes_v3_fan.what: The folding fan joins the pack (additions only): items Fan (SK_Fan) and Fan_Tassel (SK_Fan_Tassel), kind 'skeletal'; 8 instances (MI_Fan_Leaf / _Ribs / _Tassel on M_Fabric_Master, MI_Fan_Rivet on M_Steel_Master, each with its _Base); the fan's recolour_maps.json / recolour_constants.json (maps/derive_constants_fan.py); its three 8-bit Detail PNGs not imported (Detail16 used, as every item).
changes_v3_fan.masters: M_Fabric_Master and M_Steel_Master gain the usage flag 'Used with Skeletal Mesh' (settings.used_with_skeletal_mesh). It only adds the skeletal-mesh shader permutation: no graph, parameter, default or instance of any existing item changes (proved by the dump comparison in WorkFiles/fan/regression/post_fan/). Without it a cooked build renders the fan with the default material and the editor would set the flag itself (dirtying the masters). Reverting: remove the two settings keys and the two Fan items.
changes_v3_fan.code: np_skeletal.py (NEW, skeletal import / assign / sockets); np_meshes.py, np_verify.py, np_spec.py, np_render.py dispatch to it only for kind 'skeletal' (static items take the unchanged path); np_masters.py / np_dump.py know the new usage flag.

changes_v4_snowflower.what: The Snow Flower sword (SM_SnowFlower) and sheath (SM_SnowFlower_Sheath) join the pack (additions only): 10 instances (MI_SnowFlower_Blade / _Fittings on M_Steel_Master, MI_SnowFlower_Grip on M_Fabric_Master, MI_SnowFlower_Sheath_Lacquer on M_Fabric_Master with Metal From ORM on, MI_SnowFlower_Sheath_Fittings on M_Steel_Master, each with its _Base); group SnowFlower's recolour maps (maps/make_snowflower_recolour_maps.py) and constants (maps/derive_constants_snowflower.py); the two shipped 8-bit Detail PNGs not imported.
changes_v4_snowflower.masters: M_Fabric_Master gains the static switch 'Metal From ORM' (default off; 2026-09-27: its keep weight also covers baked pearl, BC luminance ramp 0.2-0.4). Off compiles the old path (append(rgb, 0) masked back), so no existing instance's look changes; proved by the dump comparison and the default base-colour captures (WorkFiles/SnowFlower/v4/materials/).
changes_v4_snowflower.code: np_spec.py: NP_SPEC_PATH / NP_ROOT overrides for isolated trial builds and texture_dirs() (the PNG accounting scans the folders the plan reads from, so the revision-3 Exports/SnowFlower/Textures is never mistaken for unaccounted maps); np_build.py: clean's disk check follows NP_ROOT; build_pack_materials.py: NP_OUT_DIR; np_masters.py: the switch.
changes_v4_snowflower.why_no_new_master: On = texels the ORM map marks metallic (blue channel) keep the original baked colour and render as metal, so baked silver ornament on a tinted part stays silver. Off = the whole part is the tinted, non-metal material.
